description: HAL ADC1 continuous scan of IN0-IN3 + temperature sensor + VREFINT into SRAM by DMA1 channel 1 (circular); values, VDDA, die temperature and scan count printed every 200 ms on USART1
expect: 72 MHz, ADCCLK = PCLK2/6 = 12 MHz. ADC1 scan + continuous, software start, right aligned, 6 ranks IN0 (PA0), IN1 (PA1), IN2 (PA2), IN3 (PA3) (analog mode), IN16 temperature sensor, IN17 VREFINT (TSVREFE), all sampled 239.5 cycles: 252 ADCCLK = 21 us per conversion, 126 us per scan, back to back. DMA1 channel 1 peripheral-to-memory, half-words, memory increment, circular, 6 items; the transfer-complete interrupt (end of each scan) snapshots the buffer and counts scans. Every 200 ms (deadline based, first 200 ms after start) USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1 prints 'in0=<r> in1=<r> in2=<r> in3=<r> ts=<r> vref=<r> vdda=<mV> temp=<C.d> seq=<n>\r\n': r = round(V / VDDA x 4095); vdda = 1200 x 4095 / vref; temp = (1430 mV - ts x vdda / 4095) / 4.3 mV/C + 25 (DS5319 typical values); n = completed scans, +1587 (200 ms / 126 us) per line. At VDD = 3.3 V and 25 C: ts=1775 vref=1489 vdda=3300 temp=25.0; a pin tied to GND reads 0, tied to 3V3 reads 4095.

circuit: PA0-PA3: nothing connected (tests/mcu/stm32f1/adc-firmware.test.ts wires PA0 to a potentiometer wiper, PA1 to GND, PA2 to 3V3 and PA3 to a 10 k / 10 k divider)
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
